a02.text: Viper 21, Sentry, radar contact. Maintain block angels 20 to 25, Bravo track.

a03.text: Texaco 31, Ghost 11, ready for pre-contact, Charlie track.

a04.text: Ghost 11, Texaco 31, cleared pre-contact. Boom is ready, say fuel state.

a05.text: Sentry, Hawg 11, target area is clear. Request battle damage assessment, over.

a06.text: Hawg 11, Sentry, roger, standby for BDA. Out.

a07.text: Sentry, Raider 41, bingo fuel. Request vector to tanker, over.

a08.text: Raider 41, Sentry, vector to Texaco, heading 270, 60 miles, angels 15.

a10.text: All players, Magic, weather update. Winds 240 at 15. Visibility 10. Altimeter 3001. Out.

a11.text: Ghost flight, comm check on Charlie Delta. Ghost 11.

a15.text: Ghost 11, Sentry, picture clean. No factors, Bullseye 090 for 120.

a17.text: Sentry, Hawg 11, tally 2 bandits, Bullseye 310, 40 miles, angels 20.

a19.text: Sentry, Hawg 11, friendly. IFF confirmed, Sierra 2. Continuing, out.

a20.text: Sentry, Raider, radio check, Alpha Charlie, over.

a21.text: Raider, Sentry, loud and clear, 5 by 5, over.

a22.text: Viper 21, Texaco, you are cleared to disconnect. Have a good 1. Out.

a23.text: Texaco, Viper 21, roger, disconnecting. Thanks for the gas.

a24.text: Sentry, Magic, new track, Bullseye 310, 120 miles, hostile.

a25.text: Magic, Sentry, roger, assign track Tango Lima to Ghost. Out.

a26.text: Sentry, Hawg 11, Fox 3, Fox 3! Bullseye 270, 60 miles.

a27.text: Hawg 11, Sentry, copy Fox 3. Splash 1 bandit. Say your state.

a28.text: Sentry, Hawg 11, Winchester. Bingo. Egressing Kilo, out.

a29.text: Sentry, Ghost 21, say again last transmission, you are broken and stepped on.

a30.text: Ghost 21, Sentry, repeat, picture clean. Over.

a31.text: All players, Texaco 31, tanker track Bravo is hot. Angels 20, playtime 15 minutes.

a32.text: Sentry, Raider 41, Oscar Mike, checking out of sector Delta. Out.

start1.text: Nighthawk 11, Sentry, radar contact. You are cleared as fragged, route Alpha to Bravo. Keep it quiet. Over.

start2.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, I hold you on the line. Point Alpha is yours. Good hunting, out.

wp1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, roger, good track. Proceed to next point, over.

wp2.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, copy point. Stay low, stay quiet. Out.

wp3.text: Sentry copies, Nighthawk is on the money. Continue to next waypoint, out.

wpc1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, clean pass. Nobody knows you were there. Continue.

wpc2.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, no radar reaction at all. Beautiful. Continue, out.

trk1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, Spike, Spike! SAM radar is painting you. Stay nose on.

trk2.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, you are being tracked. Get out of that beam.

lock1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, Mud 6, Mud 6! They have a lock. Expect a launch.

lock2.text: Nighthawk, Magic, Patriot radar is locked on. Break away, break away.

msl1.text: Missile launch, missile launch! Nighthawk, Sentry, break, break, break!

msl2.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, Patriot launch. SAM in the air! Defend, defend!

msl3.text: Mud 6, Mud 6! Nighthawk 11, defending, flares, flares!

msl4.text: Nighthawk, Magic, missile in flight. Beam it and dispense!

ok1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, missile lost lock. Good defense.

dec1.text: Missile took the decoy. Nice work, Nighthawk. Sentry out.

stall1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, check your airspeed, you are getting slow. Over.

low1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, countermeasures low. Conserve your flares, you are close to Winchester.

dead1.text: Nighthawk 11, Sentry, radio check. Nighthawk, respond, over.

dead2.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, no contact. Nighthawk, how do you read? Over.

crash1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, I have lost you on radar. Nighthawk, respond.

night1.text: Nighthawk, Sentry, night vision goggles are approved. Stay safe, over.
